title: Klarner’s constant
meaning: An upper bound on the exponential growth rate of the number of polyominoes.
artifact_description: 321 rational inequalities and their supersolution at z = 200/881.

title: Grothendieck constant of order four
meaning: A dedicated upper bound for K_G(4).
artifact_description: A rational local model on four-dimensional measurement directions, with the two shrinking-factor values.

title: Wellens’ Boolean-function bound
meaning: An upper bound on D∞, which controls the number of relevant variables of Boolean functions relative to their degree.
artifact_description: One exact infeasibility certificate and one rational feasibility witness for each degree from 1 to 48.

title: Turán density of the tetrahedron
meaning: An upper bound on the maximum asymptotic edge density of a 3-uniform hypergraph containing no tetrahedron.
artifact_description: The rounded flag-algebra certificate contains 18 rational positive-semidefinite blocks and 32 multipliers. The PSD blocks and multiplier signs were checked; the full flag-algebra identity remains unchecked.

title: Cap-body illumination
meaning: Seven improved upper bounds on illumination numbers, in dimensions 9 through 15 respectively.
artifact_description: The final discretized coefficients for each dimension. The dual inequalities hold in rational arithmetic for these coefficients.

title: Cohn–Elkies linear-programming bounds
meaning: Improved lower bounds on the best upper bound attainable by the Cohn–Elkies method, in dimensions 9 through 13.
artifact_description: One final dual vector for each dimension, with exact bound values. Values use center-density normalization.

title: Spencer discrepancy constant
meaning: A stronger lower bound on the smallest universal constant in the square-matrix discrepancy problem.
artifact_description: An explicit 8 × 8 matrix with discrepancy five over its 256 sign assignments.

title: Dimer entropy in three dimensions
meaning: A tighter upper bound on the per-site entropy of perfect matchings of the cubic lattice.
artifact_description: Positive integer vectors satisfying the transfer-operator inequalities. The final logarithm is evaluated numerically.

title: The n-queens constant
meaning: An interval for the constant α in the asymptotic count of n-queens configurations, narrowed by approximately 21×.
artifact_description: The lower witness has n = 32,768 and the upper witness has n = 2,048. The bounds use rational feasibility checks and directed rounding.

title: Ramsey multiplicity c₅
meaning: A smaller upper bound on the limiting density of monochromatic cliques in two-colorings.
artifact_description: The final graph on 768 vertices, in graph6 format and as a generating set.

title: Ramsey multiplicity c₄,₅
meaning: A smaller upper bound on the limiting density of monochromatic cliques in two-colorings.
artifact_description: The final graph on 1024 vertices, in graph6 format and as a generating set.

title: MAX-4-CUT hardness ratio
meaning: An improved gadget-based NP-hardness threshold for approximating MAX-4-CUT.
artifact_description: The integer weighted edge list giving the exact ratio 6529501/6618824.

title: Timmons’ Bₕ[g] constants
meaning: Improved upper-bound coefficients for generalized Sidon sets, for h = 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.
artifact_description: The final degree-400 cosine-polynomial coefficients for h = 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. The reported values use floating-point evaluation with an interpolation margin.

title: Quartic Feigenbaum attractor
meaning: A high-precision numerical enclosure for the Hausdorff dimension of the attractor with a quartic critical point.
artifact_description: The final fixed-point coefficients. The reported enclosure is a high-precision numerical result, without an interval-certified fixed point.

title: Quantum capacity: X-Z and 2-Pauli channels
meaning: Higher noise rates at which the supplied quantum states have positive coherent information.
artifact_description: The final state amplitudes for 37 X-Z channel uses and 35 two-Pauli channel uses. At the reported noise rates, extended-precision numerical evaluations give positive coherent-information margins of 1.66 × 10⁻⁹ and 3.26 × 10⁻⁹.
